summary: The evidence behind one step of an agent run: which tool, with what input, and what came back — collapsed by default, with any failure shown without a click.
useWhen: a person may need to check how an agent reached a result — which search it ran, which record it wrote
beneath or beside an AgentActivityStep, for the steps that called a tool
debugging or audit views where the arguments matter as much as the outcome

useInstead.when: the reader needs to know what the agent did, not how
useInstead.why: the plain-language log is the account; ToolCall is the evidence for it, and a thread of tool calls alone is a log nobody but an engineer can read

useInstead.when: the call has not happened yet and needs permission
useInstead.why: ToolCall reports a call; it does not ask whether to make one

failed.use: errored. Pass `errorMessage`, which shows without expanding

skipped.use: not run — rejected at an ApprovalGate, or a cached result was used

errorMessage.note: what went wrong, in words — not a stack trace

guarantees: the header is a disclosure button with aria-expanded; with no input and no output it is plain text instead, because a disclosure that discloses nothing is a dead control
status is rendered as visually hidden text inside the header, and the glyph differs in shape per status
each payload is a focusable, named scroll region, so a keyboard user can scroll a capped payload
errorMessage renders outside the disclosure, so a failure is never hidden behind a click
notes: it does not announce status changes — AgentActivity owns the run's live region, and a second one would talk over it
the details unmount when collapsed, unlike Accordion: a tool call holds no user state and payloads can be large

antiPatterns.why: the function name describes the implementation; the title is what tells a reader whether the step was the right one

antiPatterns.dont: passing input or output with credentials, tokens or personal data still in it
antiPatterns.why: it renders exactly what it is given, to anyone who can see the thread

antiPatterns.dont: defaultExpanded on every call in a run
antiPatterns.why: a thread of open JSON buries the answer; open the one the reader is likely to check, or none
a failure the reader cannot diagnose is just a red mark
